snippet.title: R-TYPE DX: Music Encore - Gameplay Trailer [EN Sub]
snippet.description:
R-TYPE DX, originally released for handhelds in 1999, now features new "what-if" sounds that didn't exist back then.
Experience these new tracks in "Ultimate Challenge," a special mode where you can play through the series' origins, R-TYPE and R-TYPE II, back-to-back.
Packed with convenient features like Rewind, Quick Save & Load, Rapid Fire, and Power-Up Start.
